title: Bias of the seed distribution
statement: For every small-bias input, the distribution on binary vectors obtained by applying the seed map to a uniformly random Boolean string of length twice the chosen field degree is biased: every nonzero character coefficient has absolute value at most the input's prescribed bias parameter.
hypotheses_covered: A small-bias input, with positive output dimension and numerator and twice the numerator at most the denominator
